intro.title: The kinds of systems we build.
intro.description: Four representative solution designs showing how we approach architecture, delivery, and outcomes. They illustrate our capabilities and are not client case studies.

items.title: AI Knowledge & Document Platform
items.description: A retrieval-augmented assistant and document-processing pipeline that turns contracts, manuals, and reports into answers teams can trust.
items.overview: Teams lose hours searching across documents. This blueprint ingests files from existing storage, extracts and indexes their content, and exposes a conversational interface that cites its sources, with role-based access so people only see what they are permitted to.
items.challenge: Information scattered across shared drives, email attachments, and legacy systems, with no reliable way to search or summarize it.
approach: Ingestion pipeline with OCR and structured extraction
Hybrid keyword and vector retrieval with citations
Evaluation set to measure answer quality over time
Role-based access and full audit logging

items.title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform
items.description: A subscription-based platform with tenant isolation, role-based access, billing, and an admin console, ready to scale from MVP to production.
items.overview: A reference architecture for turning a product idea into a billable SaaS. It covers tenant data isolation, user and permission management, subscription plans, usage tracking, and the operational tooling needed to run the product day to day.
items.challenge: Launching quickly without painting the product into an architectural corner that blocks multi-tenancy, billing, or enterprise features later.
approach: Tenant-aware data model and access layer
Admin console for support and operations
CI/CD with staging and production environments

items.title: Unified Data & Reporting Platform
items.description: Automated pipelines that consolidate data from finance, sales, and operations systems into one trusted model with live dashboards.
items.overview: Reporting often means manual exports and conflicting spreadsheets. This blueprint pulls from each source system on a schedule, validates and reconciles the data, and publishes a single source of truth with dashboards leaders can rely on.
items.challenge: Multiple systems, inconsistent definitions, and manual month-end reporting that is slow and error-prone.
approach: Transformation layer with documented business rules
Automated data quality checks and alerts
outcomes: One consistent view of the business

items.title: IoT Monitoring & Alerting System
items.description: Real-time telemetry ingestion, dashboards, and anomaly alerts for connected equipment, with a path towards predictive maintenance.
items.overview: Connected equipment generates data that rarely reaches the people who can act on it. This blueprint ingests device telemetry, stores it efficiently, visualizes live status, and raises alerts when readings drift outside expected behavior.
items.challenge: Equipment health is invisible until something fails, and device data is locked in proprietary tools.
approach: Device and gateway integration over standard protocols
Live dashboards by site, asset, and sensor
